summary: The diff implements both REQ-1 (PDF export fix) and REQ-2 (chart image export fix) with strong coverage. REQ-2 is fully addressed: chart components now use a separate ref pointing only to the chart wrapper div (excluding the download button), and useChartExport.ts selects the largest SVG element, clones it with inlined styles, renders to a 2x canvas with white background, and downloads as PNG. REQ-1 is largely addressed: print CSS in index.css overrides ScrollArea overflow clipping, expands chart containers, hides UI chrome, and usePdfExport.ts uses double requestAnimationFrame + 800ms setTimeout before calling window.print(). All three chart components and both table components are updated with the appropriate print CSS classes. No hallucinated features were identified.
